concept.name: Ask
concept.definition: A displayed or communicated offer to sell a specified quantity at a stated price, also called an offer.
concept.intuition: It describes the immediately available terms and ease of trading in an order-driven market.
concept.mechanics: Sell orders are aggregated by venue and price; the best ask is the lowest eligible displayed sell price, subject to its available quantity and priority.
concept.failure_modes: Displayed quotes and depth can cancel, fragment across venues, or vanish under stress, so snapshots can overstate executable liquidity.
concept.misconceptions: A quote or narrow spread is not a guarantee that a large order can trade at that price without delay or impact.
concept.example: A quote of $50.05 ask for 300 means a seller currently offers up to the displayed 300 shares at $50.05.
